descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S27 Save & Extract on one patient leaves every other patient's matching tasks alone (two patients per context)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given make-session with two Hospital patients (A = {hospitalPatient}, B = {hospitalPatient2}) and two residents (R = {snfResident}, R2 = {snfResident2}), all In Today by the snf:add default; every chart seeded with 'follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks'

When Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text on A only; open Hospital and Nursing Home Task Export. Then Save & Extract on R only; open both Task Exports again. The run copies rounding:list / snf:list before and after each step

Then After A: only A's BMP and PT under Finished Tasks; B's, R's and R2's three tasks pending and unchanged; the diet task only under A. After R: R's BMP and PT finished; R2 unchanged; A's and B's tasks as after the first step; the diet task under A and R only

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2 closes this patient's answered tasks; U4 every other patient's tasks stay open; U3 nothing duplicated onto another chart. Decided first on the stored tasks (B and R2 deep-equal before/after; R unchanged by the step on A, A by the step on R), then on Task Export grouped by patient (section-scoped: each patient's pending list and the Finished Tasks rows carry the right name). …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
